entries.name: GlobalNavigationHeader
entries.purpose: Standard top navigation header for home/global pages.
strain_notes: Top chrome should enter AppScreen.top through this or a domain shell.

entries.name: GlobalNavigationBar
strain_notes: If a route needs bottom navigation, compose it in AppScreen.bottom.

entries.name: GlobalSearch
entries.purpose: Search top chrome that combines search top bar and result tabs.
absorbs: search result tabs in top slot
strain_notes: Search tabs should not be separately fixed in route body.

entries.name: ProgressTopBar
entries.purpose: Flow top bar with title, leading affordance, and optional progress label.
strain_notes: Progress placement should be declared in x_interfacePlan.progress_location.

entries.name: FlowHero
strain_notes: Avoid repeating the same text as a SectionCard title immediately below.

entries.name: FlowSummaryCard
entries.purpose: Domain-neutral summary card for flow/result facts.
strain_notes: Completion screens should prefer unified summary over per-step messages.

entries.name: TermsAgreementGroup
entries.purpose: Domain wrapper around ConsentList for terms agreement flows.
strain_notes: Good candidate for stronger x_interactions all-agree contracts.

entries.name: FlowPersonalInfoForm
strain_notes: Optional/null data should be resolved before fields reach the organism.

entries.name: FlowReasonForm
entries.purpose: Reason selection form with optional detail input.
strain_notes: Textarea visibility policy should be recorded in x_stateMatrix.

entries.name: FlowNotice
entries.purpose: Domain wrapper for NoticeBlock in flow screens.
strain_notes: Policy/legal notices should map to x_policyExtract.legal_notices.

entries.name: FlowContinueBar
entries.purpose: Flow bottom CTA with primary action and optional blocked/helper state.
strain_notes: Prefer PrimaryCTABar when the screen is SDUI-driven; keep state/CTA alignment explicit.
